title: Breach Court Whisperer
text: Breach Court Whisperer delivers sealed decrees directly into nearby receivers without opening its mouth. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The order arrives already marked as acknowledged.

defeatReward.text: Breach Court Whisperer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
